ja530:1.1: Disvā nisinnaṃ rājānaṃ Brahmadattaṃ rathesabhaṃ ath' assa paṭivedesi yassāsi anukampako:
ja530:2.1: Saṃkicc' āyaṃ anuppatto isīnaṃ sādhusammato, taramānarūpo niyyāhi, khippaṃ passa mahesinaṃ.
ja530:3.1: Tato (ca) rājā taramāno yuttam āruyha sandanaṃ mittāmaccaparibbūḷho agamāsi rathesabho.
ja530:4.1: Nikkhippa pañca kakudhāni Kāsīnaṃ ratthavaḍḍhano vāḷavījaniṃ uṇhīsaṃ khaggaṃ chattaṃ upāhanaṃ
ja530:5.1: Oruyha rājā yānamhā ṭhapayitvā paṭicchadaṃ āsīnaṃ Dāyapassasmiṃ Saṃkiccam upasaṃkami.
ja530:6.1: Upasaṃkamitvā (so) rājā sammodi isinā saha, taṃ kathaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ upāvisi.
ja530:7.1: Ekamantaṃ nisinno va yathā kālaṃ amaññatha tato pāpāni kammāni pucchituṃ paccapajjatha.
ja530:8.1: Isiṃ pucchāmi Saṃkiccaṃ isīnaṃ sādhusammataṃ āsīnaṃ Dāyapassasmiṃ isisaṃghapurakkhataṃ:
ja530:9.1: Kaṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchanti narā dhammāticārino, aticiṇṇo mayā dhammo, tam me akkhāhi pucchito.
ja530:10.1: Isi avaca Saṃkicco Kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhanaṃ āsīnaṃ Dāyapassasmiṃ, mahārāja suṇohi me:
ja530:11.1: Uppathena vajantassa yo maggam anusāsati tassa ve vacanaṃ kayirā nāssa maggeyya kaṇṭako.
ja530:12.1: Adhammaṃ paṭipannassa yo dhammam anusāsati tassa ve vacanaṃ kayirā na so gaccheyya duggatin ti.
ja530:13.1: Dhammo patho mahārāja adhammo pana uppatho, adhammo nirayaṃ neti dhammo pāpeti suggatiṃ. (IV 496|18).
ja530:14.1: Adhammacārino rāja narā visamajīvino yaṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchanti niraye te suṇohi me:
ja530:15.1: Sañjīvo Kāḷasutto ca Saṃghāto dve ca Roruvā athāparo Mahāvīci Tapano ca Patāpano.
ja530:16.1: Icc-ete aṭṭha nirayā akkhātā duratikkamā ākiṇṇā luddakammehi paccekā soḷas' ussadā
ja530:17.1: Kadariyātapanā ghorā accimantā mahabbhayā lomahaṃsanarūpā ca bhesmā paṭibhayā dukhā
ja530:18.1: Catukkaṇṇā catudvārā vibhattā bhāgaso mitā ayopākārapariyantā ayasā paṭikujjitā.
ja530:19.1: Tesaṃ ayomayā bhūmi jalitā tejasā yutā, samantā yojanasataṃ phuṭā tiṭṭhanti sabbadā.
ja530:20.1: Ete patanti niraye uddhapādā avaṃsirā isīnaṃ ativattāro saññatānaṃ tapassinaṃ.
ja530:21.1: Te bhūnahuno paccanti macchābhīlā katā yathā saṃvacchare asaṃkheyye narā kibbisakārino.
ja530:22.1: Dayhamānena gattena niccaṃ santarabāhiraṃ nirayā nādhigacchanti dvāraṃ nikkhamanesino.
ja530:23.1: Puratthimena dhāvanti tato dhāvanti pacchato, uttarena pi dhāvanti tato dhāvanti dakkhiṇaṃ, yaṃ yaṃ dvāraṃ gacchanti taṃ taṃ devā pithīyare.
ja530:24.1: Bahūni vassasahassāni janā nirayavāsino bāhā paggayha kandanti patvā dukkhaṃ anappakaṃ.
ja530:25.1: Āsīvisaṃ va kupitaṃ tejasiṃ duratikkamaṃ na sādhurūpe āsīde na saññatānaṃ tapassinaṃ.
ja530:26.1: Atikāyo mahissāso Ajjuno Kekakādhipo sahassabāhu ucchinno isim āsajja Gotamaṃ.
ja530:27.1: Arajaṃ rajasā Vacchaṃ Kisam avakiriya Daṇḍakī tālo va mūlato chinno, sa rājā vibhavaṃ gato.
ja530:28.1: Upahacca manaṃ Mejjho Mātaṅgasmiṃ yasassine (IV 389|27) sapārisajjo ucchinno, Mejjhāraññaṃ tadā ahu.
ja530:29.1: Kaṇhadīpāyan' āsajja isiṃ Andhakaveṇhuyo aññaññaṃ musale hantvā sampattā Yamasādanaṃ.
ja530:30.1: Athāyaṃ isinā satto antalikkhacaro pure (III 460|1) pāvekkhi paṭhaviṃ Cecco hīnatto patta pariyāyaṃ.
ja530:31.1: Tasmā hi chandāgamanaṃ nā-ppasaṃsanti paṇḍitā, aduṭṭhacitto bhāseyya giraṃ saccupasaṃhitaṃ, (III 460|3)
ja530:32.1: Manasā ce paduṭṭhena yo naro pekkhate muniṃ vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ gantā so nirayaṃ adho.
ja530:33.1: Ye vaddhe paribhāsenti pharusūpakkamā janā anapaccā adāyādā tālāvatthu bhavanti te.
ja530:34.1: Yo ca pabbajitaṃ hanti katakiccaṃ mahesinaṃ sa Kāḷasutte niraye cirarattāya paccati.
ja530:35.1: Yo ca rājā adhammaṭṭho raṭṭhaviddhaṃsano mago tāpayitvā janapadaṃ Tapane pecca paccati.
ja530:36.1: So ca vassasahassāni sataṃ divyāni paccati accisaṃghapareto so dukkhaṃ vedeti vedanaṃ.
ja530:37.1: Tassa aggisikhā kāyā niccharanti pabhassarā tejobhakkhassa gattāni lomaggehi nakhehi ca.
ja530:38.1: Dayhamānena gattena niccaṃ santarabāhiraṃ dukkhābhitunno nadati nāgo tuttaddito yathā.
ja530:39.1: Yo lobhā pitaraṃ hanti dosā vā purisādhamo sa Kāḷasutte niraye cirarattāni paccati.
ja530:40.1: Sa tādiso paccati lohakumbhiyā, pakkañ ca sattīhi hananti nittacaṃ andhaṃ karitvā muttakarīsabhakkhaṃ, khāre nimujjanti tathāvidhaṃ naraṃ.
ja530:41.1: Tattaṃ pakaṭṭhitaṃ ayogulañ ca dīghe ca phāle cirarattatāpite vikkhambham ādāya vibhajjā rajjuhi vatte mukhe saṃsavayanti rakkhasā.
ja530:42.1: Sāmā ca soṇā ca balā ca gijjhā kākolasaṃghā ca dijā ayomukhā saṃgamma khādanti vipphandamānaṃ jivhaṃ vibhajja vighāsaṃ salohitaṃ.
ja530:43.1: Taṃ daḍḍhakoḷaṃ paribhinnagattaṃ nippothayantā (anu)vicaranti rakkhasā, ratī hi nesaṃ, dukhino pan' ītare, etādisasmiṃ niraye vasanti ye keci loke idha pettighātino.
ja530:44.1: Putto ca mātaraṃ hantvā ito gantvā Yamakkhayaṃ bhusam āpajjate dukkhaṃ attakammaphalūpago.
ja530:45.1: Amanussā atibalā hantāraṃ janayantiyā ayomayehi phālehi pīḷayanti punappunaṃ.
ja530:46.1: Taṃ passutaṃ sakā gattā ruhiraṃ attasambhavaṃ tambalohavilīnaṃ va tattaṃ pāyenti mattighaṃ.
ja530:47.1: Jighaññaṃ kuṇapaṃ pūti duggandhaṃ gūthakaddamaṃ pubbalohitasaṃkāsaṃ rahadaṃ ogayha tiṭṭhati.
ja530:48.1: Tam enaṃ kimayo tattha atikāyā ayomukhā chaviṃ chetvāna khādanti pagiddhā maṃsalohite.
ja530:49.1: So ca taṃ nirayaṃ patto nimuggo Sataporisaṃ pūtīnaṃ kuṇapaṃ vāti samantā satayojanaṃ.
ja530:50.1: Cakkhumāpī hi cakkhūhi tena gandhena jīyati, etādisaṃ Brahmadatta mattigho labhate dukhaṃ.
ja530:51.1: Khuradhāram anukkamma tikkhaṃ durabhisambhavaṃ patanti gabbhapātiniyo duggaṃ Vetaraṇīnadiṃ.
ja530:52.1: Ayomayā simbaliyo soḷasaṃgulakaṇṭakā dubhato-m-abhilambanti duggaṃ Vetaraṇiṃ nadiṃ.
ja530:53.1: Te accimanto tiṭṭhanti aggikkhandhā va ārakā, ādittā jātavedena uddhaṃ yojanam uggatā.
ja530:54.1: Ete sajanti niraye tatte tikhiṇakaṇṭake nāriyo ca aticāriniyo narā ca paradāragū.
ja530:55.1: Te patanti adhakkhandhā vivattā vihatā puthū, sayanti vinividdhaṅgā, dīghaṃ jagganti saṃvariṃ.
ja530:56.1: Tato ratyā vivasane mahatiṃ pabbatūpamaṃ lohakumbhiṃ pavajjanti tattaṃ aggisamūdakaṃ.
ja530:57.1: Evaṃ divā ca ratto ca dussīlā mohapārutā anubhonti sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe dukkatam attano.
ja530:58.1: Yā ca bhariyā dhanakkītā sāmikaṃ atimaññati sassuṃ vā sasuraṃ vāpi jeṭṭhaṃ vāpi nanandaraṃ
ja530:59.1: tassā vaṃkena jivhaggaṃ nibbahanti sabandhanaṃ. Sā vyāmamattaṃ kiminaṃ jivhaṃ passati attani, viññāpetuṃ na sakkoti, Tapane pecca paccati.
ja530:60.1: Orabbhikā sūkarikā macchikā migabandhikā corā goghātakā ḷuddā avaṇṇe vaṇṇakārakā
ja530:61.1: Sattīhi lohakūṭehi nettiṃsehi usūhi ca haññamānā khāranadiṃ papatanti avaṃsirā.
ja530:62.1: Sāyaṃ pāto kūṭakārī ayokūṭehi haññati, tato vantaṃ durattānaṃ paresaṃ bhuñjate sadā.
ja530:63.1: Dhaṃkā bheraṇḍakā gijjhā kākoḷā ca ayomukhā vipphandamānaṃ khādanti naraṃ kibbisakārinaṃ.
ja530:64.1: Ye migena migaṃ hanti pakkhiṃ vā pana pakkhinā asanto rajasā channā gantā te nirayaṃ adho ti.
ja530:65.1: Santo ca uddhaṃ gacchanti suciṇṇen' idha kammanā, suciṇṇassa phalaṃ passa: saindadevā sabrahmakā.
ja530:66.1: Taṃ taṃ brūmi mahārāja: dhammaṃ raṭṭhapatī cara, tathā tathā rāja carāhi dhammaṃ yathā taṃ suciṇṇaṃ nānutappeyya peccā 'ti.
